home.title: Software from the kernel up.
home.subtitle: Daniel Limón is a technology holding company. We build, fund, and operate software ventures — from operating-system kernels to autonomous agents.

ventures.title: Our companies
ventures.subtitle: Four subsidiaries, built and operated as one group.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.subtitle: Direct line to the operator — not a form into a queue.

philosophy.title: One operator. Four companies. One standard.
philosophy.lede: A holding only earns the name when it runs what it owns.

principles.title: Build, don't resell.
principles.body: Every subsidiary is built and run to the same engineering standard. No outsourced core, no white-labelled product — the hard parts are ours.

principles.title: From the kernel up.
principles.body: Operating-system kernels, automotive stacks, autonomous agents. We invest where the work is hardest and the layers are lowest.

principles.title: Honesty over hype.
principles.body: Our AI agents reason inside sandboxes and self-debug under a microscope. We build for verifiable truth, not for demos.

items.body: We fund the companies we run — capital aligned to engineering, not to a pitch deck.
Kernels, firmware, agents, dashboards — shipped to the standard we hold ourselves to.
We don't flip what we build. We run our companies for the long term.

cta.title: Building something hard?
cta.body: If your work lives close to the metal — a kernel, a fleet, an agent — we'd like to hear about it.

about.title: Daniel Limón runs what he owns.
about.lede: Engineer first, operator second — the holding is one person's standard applied to four companies.
about.body1: Daniel Limón is the operator behind the holding. The group doesn't buy equity in other people's companies; it's one engineering standard applied to the software the holding builds and runs itself — kernels, automotive stacks, autonomous agents, and the design arm that sets the visual bar for all of them.
about.body2: The work sits close to the metal: operating-system kernels, firmware and drivers, autonomous driving, and AI agents that reason inside sandboxes. Nothing here is resold or relabelled.
